data.turoyo: <...> i ʕaraṣa d kətwa ʕam gabayye, əno diḏi wa, həwowali li ʕaskariye, saymowala taʕlimgah, məstamləkulle meni b kallat. <...>
data.translation: <...> The plot that was beside them was mine; I had given it to the military. They were making it a training ground; they expropriated it from me for money. <...>

rationale: First II Preterit example; overt property antecedent, military use, owner-source and payment. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.

data.turoyo: <...> Lə kowe d mzabnatla, d saymət harke loqantat w flan w dukkane, i ʕaskar gəd mahzəmo mu taʕlim gəd mičoko bayn ad dukkane lə ksaymo taʕlim. Kəbʕina aḥna d məstamləkinala...“
data.translation: <...> You cannot sell it and make restaurants and so on and shops here. The soldiers will run away from training; they will slip in among the shops and will not do training. We want to expropriate it...'

rationale: First II Infectum example; military stated intention and indexed feminine property theme. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.

data.turoyo: <...> Heš lə məstamləkulle, kəlla i saḥayo xliṯo, heš lə mzabnoli.
data.translation: <...> They still haven't expropriated it; that whole plot is lying vacant. I still haven't sold it.

rationale: Second II Preterit example; heš lə not-yet construction distinguishes pending acquisition from the earlier completed clause. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.
